title: Synthesize the unique full-Bose optimum for a scalar passive single-backbone cell
statement: For every K>0, M>m0>0 and finite theta>0, the minimum full Bose-weighted ideal ballistic conductance over the declared finite passive internal networks with total mass M and backbone m>=m0 is attained at m=m0 by one side mass M-m0 and one finite positive spring. Optimal passbands and active driving-point response are unique; hardware topology and dark modes need not be.

requires: Finite connected passive scalar positive-mass/positive-spring internal network per periodic cell
One rank-one intercell spring K linking a single backbone coordinate
Ideal-contact full-spectrum one-dimensional harmonic ballistic conductance, including optical bands
provides: Unique positive optical start r* from one scalar derivative zero, without topology search
A=4K/m0, B=4K/M, Delta=sqrt((r^2+A)^2-4Br^2); p^2=(r^2+A-Delta)/2, s^2=(r^2+A+Delta)/2 give bands [0,p] union [r,s]
Global analytic resource inverse, positive local curvature and strict rigid-chain improvement at every finite theta
assumptions: Unlimited internal stiffness; no connector-mass, geometry, strength, contact, extra-polarization or anharmonicity constraint
No specimen, measurement, device benefit or historical novelty established
Retuning at each temperature does not describe one fixed device
Spring-cap and compliance-constrained variants have separate contracts
costs: Two active masses, one internal spring and declared intercell spring
Certified scalar evaluation, bracketing and bisection precision must be paid
No uniform conditioning near resource/temperature limits; k* may violate a fabrication cap
contract.units: K is stiffness; M/m0 masses; theta/endpoints angular frequencies; physical conductance is k_B/(2pi) times J
contract.obstruction: Solves all-topology optimization only in the rank-one scalar harmonic ideal-contact model. A changed contact/material/stiffness/compliance contract needs its own theorem.

evidence.range_scope: Governing universal family v3, including zero-coefficient and dimensionless-log clarifications.

body: Exact trace/log moments, an attained two-mass curve, proper-quadrant all-frequency root counting and dual signs prove the optimum. v3 fixes the frequency reference in logarithms. Root audit states its exposed warm history and checks the exact delta.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
